names.fullName: Unsupervised, automated mining of biomedical texts: analysis of protein-protein co-mentioning
Import of protein-protein association information from curated knowledge databases
Global analysis of protein-protein interaction data, obtained from the literature and from large-scale datasets (BIND database)
Combined analysis of available microarray data, co-expression analysis
Analysis of presence/absence patterns of genes in genomes: functional partners co-occur
Detection of gene fusion events: functional linkage inferred for the separate components in other genomes
Probabilistic, benchmarked integration of all evidence types: combined confidence score of predicted functional association (range 0.0 to 1.0)
Protein NLP7; Transcription factor involved in regulation of nitrate assimilation and in transduction of the nitrate signal.

Protein NRT1/ PTR FAMILY 6.3; Dual affinity nitrate transporter. Involved in proton- dependent nitrate uptake and in the regulation of the nitrate transporter NRT2.1. Acts also as a nitrate sensor that trigger a specific signaling pathway stimulating lateral root growth and seed germination. The uptake activity is not required for sensor function. Displays an auxin transport facilitation inhibited by high nitrate concentration. protein

High-affinity nitrate transporter 2.1; Involved in nitrate transport, but does not seem to be able to mediate transport by its own. Acts as a dual component transporter with NTR3.1. Acts as a repressor of lateral root initiation under high sucrose/low nitrate conditions.
protein
Nitrate reductase [NADH] 1; Nitrate reductase is a key enzyme involved in the first step of nitrate assimilation in plants, fungi and bacteria.
protein
Ferredoxin--nitrite reductase, chloroplastic; Catalyzes the six-electron reduction of nitrite to ammonium. Belongs to the nitrite and sulfite reductase 4Fe-4S domain family.
protein
Nitrate regulatory gene2 protein; Required for nitrate signaling. Regulates expression of the nitrate-responsive genes NIA1, NIR1, NRT2.1 and NPF6.3/NRT1.1.

Nitrate reductase [NADH] 2; Nitrate reductase is a key enzyme involved in the first step of nitrate assimilation in plants, fungi and bacteria.
protein
MADS-box transcription factor ANR1; Probable transcription factor. Required for root plasticity in response to nitrate, NO(3)(-). Promotes lateral root growth in a NRT1.1-dependent manner.
protein

Calcium-dependent protein kinase 30; May play a role in signal transduction pathways that involve calcium as a second messenger. May be a positive regulator controlling stress signal transduction. Acts as a calcium sensor involved in the hormone-signaling pathways.
protein

Transcription factor TGA1; Transcriptional activator that binds specifically to the DNA sequence 5'-TGACG-3'. Recognizes ocs elements like the as-1 motif of the cauliflower mosaic virus 35S promoter. Binding to the as-1-like cis elements mediate auxin- and salicylic acid-inducible transcription. May be involved in the induction of the systemic acquired resistance (SAR) via its interaction with NPR1. Could also bind to the Hex-motif (5'- TGACGTGG-3') another cis-acting element found in plant histone promoters; Belongs to the bZIP family.
